INSERT INTO fms.work_order_labor
          (tenant_id, work_order_id, user_id, started_at, ended_at, minutes)
        SELECT $1, $2, $3,
               coalesce(w.actual_start_at, clock_timestamp())
                 - ($4::int * interval '1 minute'),
               coalesce(w.actual_start_at, clock_timestamp()),
               $4
        FROM fms.work_orders w
        WHERE w.id = $2
